title: System Control Board: a row's answer under the row, full width
why: Jason, 2026-11-18, with a screenshot of the Workers' Check: the answer ('Ready: Last check-in 55 seconds…') ran down the page a letter at a time. Since the rows release (#931) put Check, Start and Shut down on each row's line, the site's notice was placed beside the button, inside the row's narrow button cell. A button on a row's line now answers under the whole row at full width; its 'are you sure' (Shut down) goes there too, and pressing it doesn't open or close the row. The board's 30-second redraw, and the redraw a second after each press, keep that notice where it is instead of wiping it. Only website/js/admin-control.js changes. Rendered at 390px and 1280px: the notice spans the row and is still there after the redraw; Shut down's ask is under its row; no sideways scroll. Built on Sync 17:20 UTC, after #931 went live.
